purpose: Disambiguate the natural 41C1 response from a ceiling hit using an unpatched W1L1 route and the following descriptor probe.

method.callback_capture: execute watches with complete player records and minimal pool/global snapshots
method.route: 20 KBD_right:30 phases, then KBD_right+KBD_space+KBD_up:5; post-jump callbacks sampled with zero frame spacing

interpretation: This route demonstrates that 41C1 is reachable at an ordinary ascent-to-fall boundary with an empty descriptor probe. It is not evidence of a natural ceiling hit or of one-way polarity.
does_not_prove: that the 41C1 event was caused by a flagged MAP cell
next: Route to a flagged W1L1 descriptor tile (0x28/0x29 or 0x2A/0x2B) and capture 41C1 plus the descriptor probe at the actual contact boundary.
